en: The electronic purse shall allow only card issuer personnel holding the administrator role to change the spending limit stored on a card, and shall deny every other user the ability to view that limit.
The data warehousing system shall permit only users assigned the data steward role to edit dimension table definitions, and shall deny read access to those definitions to all users lacking that role.
The compiler shall detect source files crafted to trigger buffer overflows in its parser, reject them, and terminate compilation without executing any embedded content.
The online banking application shall block any client session that submits more than ten malformed requests within one minute while continuing to serve all other sessions normally.
The electronic purse shall enter a locked state that refuses all transactions when it detects voltage or clock manipulation intended to induce faults in the card chip.

The online banking application shall detect automated credential-stuffing traffic, block the offending source addresses, and send an alert to the security administrator each time such traffic is detected.

The sales forecasting system shall reject repeated submissions of crafted input designed to exhaust its model-training service and shall inform the system administrator whenever such a submission is blocked.
The database server must detect SQL injection attempts, refuse the offending statements, and send a notification to the database administrator for every blocked attempt.
The electronic purse shall accept a payment request only from a terminal that proves its identity with a valid certificate issued by the scheme operator.
The web browser shall verify that a synchronisation service presents a valid certificate matching its claimed domain name before establishing a synchronisation session with it.
The electronic purse shall require the cardholder to enter the correct PIN before it authorises any payment.
The smart-home IoT controller must require each person using the mobile app to present a registered account name and its matching credential before it accepts any device command.
The compiler's cloud build service shall allow only users who present a valid, registered identity token to submit compilation jobs.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to prove their identity with a registered account before it uploads any recording to the shared team library.
The simulation software must verify the identity of each operator against the organisation's directory before granting the operator the ability to launch a simulation run.
The data warehousing system shall load each record so that the stored values match exactly the values in the source extract, and shall flag any record whose checksum differs after loading.
The online booking system shall store every reservation with the same dates, times and guest details that the customer submitted at confirmation.
The compiler shall guarantee that constant values written in the source code appear unchanged in the generated binary.
The air traffic control software shall encrypt flight plans exchanged with ground stations and shall block and report any attempt to intercept or replay messages on those links.
The database server shall encrypt customer records at rest and shall block any connection that attempts to extract bulk data through repeated abnormal queries.

The data warehousing system shall refrain from sending personal data to external reporting services without the data subject's consent and shall detect and block exfiltration attempts made through compromised accounts.
The online booking system shall reject any reservation request whose check-out date precedes its check-in date or whose guest count is not a positive whole number.
The hospital patient-record system shall refuse entry of a blood-pressure reading outside the physiologically possible range and shall require the clinician to correct the value.
The compiler shall validate that every build configuration option holds a value of its declared type within its permitted range and shall abort the build when any option fails this check.
The online booking system shall reject a second simultaneous sign-in by the same travel agent from a different device and shall display a warning on both devices.
The data warehousing system shall lock an analyst account for 15 minutes after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts.
The sales forecasting system shall block any client that submits more than 100 forecast requests per minute and shall return a rejection message to that client.
The payroll system shall let users without payroll-administrator rights view salary records but shall prevent them from creating, editing or deleting any record.
The data warehousing system must grant guest analysts view-only access to fact tables and must block every insert, update and delete operation they attempt.
The electronic purse shall let a terminal lacking issuer rights read the card balance but shall refuse any command from that terminal that would change the stored balance.
The compiler's web-based IDE shall terminate a session after 15 minutes without user input so that an unattended workstation cannot be exploited by an intruder.
The smart-home IoT controller shall close the administrative interface session after ten minutes without interaction and shall require a new session to be started before further changes.
The payroll and human resources management system shall end an employee's session after 10 minutes without activity to prevent misuse of an abandoned browser.

The compiler shall verify the identity of a developer through valid credentials before accepting any build, configuration or plugin-management command, except the command that starts the sign-in dialog.
The smart-home controller must authenticate every person or companion app by checking a registered identity before executing any device command other than the pairing sign-in request.

The web browser shall allow an administrator to assign read permission and write permission separately for each of its components, such as stored passwords, bookmarks, history and extensions, so that a user can view or change only the components granted to that user.

The simulation software must let a project owner define, per module (model editor, solver, results viewer), which users may view its content and which users may alter it, with each grant independent of the others.
The hospital patient-record system shall allow only users holding the physician role to amend a diagnosis entry, and it must reject amendment attempts from every other role.
The web browser must permit modification of enterprise policy settings solely by a signed-in device administrator and must refuse such changes from ordinary profiles.
The simulation software shall restrict the creation, editing and deletion of validated reference scenarios to users assigned the lead engineer role.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to sign in with an individual account identifier that no other user shares before uploading recordings to the cloud library.
The compiler service must identify every developer by a distinct credential tied to a single account before it accepts remote compilation jobs.

The online booking system shall grant each user only the view and edit capabilities defined for the role assigned to that user, so that, for example, a front-desk agent can see reservations of its own branch but cannot change tariff tables.
The smart-home controller must map every household member to a role such as owner, guest or child, and must expose device status and device control only to the extent that the role allows.
The screen capture tool must force a user to replace the sign-in secret of a cloud account every 90 days before further sign-ins are accepted.
The online banking application shall require customers to renew their login credentials at least once every quarter and shall refuse to authenticate a customer whose renewal is overdue.
The compiler shall allow only the designated build manager to change the optimisation and target-platform settings of a shared project.
The hospital patient-record system must restrict changes to ward-level clinical protocol templates to the ward's chief physician.
The payroll and human resources management system shall let only a payroll administrator modify tax-rate tables and pay-grade definitions.
The database server shall verify checksums of stored data pages on every read and must report any page whose content differs from what was last written.
The web browser must check the cryptographic hash of each downloaded update package against the published value and must discard the package when the values differ.

The payroll and human resources management system shall validate that salary amounts, dates and employee identifiers entered or imported are within permitted ranges and formats and must reject records that are inconsistent.
The screen capture tool must end the active session and require renewed sign-in after 15 minutes without user interaction.
The sales forecasting system shall terminate any session that has seen no activity for 30 minutes, so that an unattended workstation cannot be used by a passer-by.
The data warehousing system must automatically close query-console sessions after 20 minutes of idleness and discard their session tokens.
The data warehousing client shall terminate the authenticated session and invalidate its session token on the server whenever the user closes the client.
The smart-home companion app must end its control session and revoke the access token when the app is shut down, so a lost phone cannot continue operating the home.
The smart-card electronic purse terminal software shall close the card session and clear any transaction authorisation as soon as the terminal application exits.
The data warehousing system shall grant access to the reporting portal only after the identity of an approved analyst has been successfully verified.
The smart-home controller must let a registered resident open the control dashboard once the controller has confirmed that resident's identity.
The sales forecasting system must allow a registered sales manager to enter the forecast workspace after that manager's identity has been proven through the sign-in procedure.
The air traffic control software shall accept the creation of a flight-plan amendment only from controllers who hold the write privilege for that sector.
The screen capture tool must permit only users granted the editor permission to trim, annotate or delete shared recordings.
The simulation software shall allow only users with the modify permission to start a change request on a baseline model.
The smart-home IoT controller shall verify a homeowner's credentials against the stored account record before granting access to the device configuration panel.
The payroll and human resources management system must require every department manager to prove their identity with a valid login credential before displaying the salary approval screen.

The database server shall apply a change to any account credential to every service endpoint and node of the server, so that the superseded credential is rejected everywhere at the next login attempt.

The payroll and human resources management system must enforce a reset of an employee's login credential across all of its modules, including the time-sheet and benefits portals, so that identity checks always use the latest credential.
The smart-home IoT controller shall propagate a revoked or updated user credential to all paired hubs and mobile apps so that each one authenticates the user only with the current credential.

The screen capture tool shall end the active recording session and lock the application when no user input has been received for a configurable idle interval, limiting exploitation of an unattended session.

The smart-card electronic purse must close its open transaction session and require a fresh start after the card has been idle for a defined time, so that an abandoned session cannot be abused by an attacker.
The data warehousing system shall terminate any analyst's query session that has shown no activity for a set period, preventing a hijacker from taking over the abandoned connection.
The online banking application must present a challenge that only a human can solve after a series of consecutive failed login attempts, in order to block automated guessing attacks.

The screen capture tool shall require the user to complete a human-verification challenge before accepting further activation-key entries once repeated invalid entries are detected, thereby blocking scripted brute-force attempts.

The simulation software shall demand a solved anti-automation challenge before processing additional remote job submissions from a client that has sent many rejected requests, so that bots cannot flood the service.

The hospital patient-record system shall delegate the verification of each clinician's identity to the hospital's central directory service and shall deny access when that service does not confirm the claimed identity.
The screen capture tool must rely on the enterprise single sign-on provider to confirm who a user is before it unlocks any of its recording features.
The simulation software shall allow only users holding the lead-engineer role to view and to edit the parameters of a scenario, and shall refuse both operations for every other user.
The screen capture tool must permit only the recording's owner to open, and to trim or overwrite, a saved capture, and must deny those actions to all other accounts.
The database server shall verify the identity of each connecting client with a valid credential before opening a session.
The data warehousing system must confirm the claimed identity of every analyst and every scheduled loading job through a verifiable credential before it accepts a connection.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to sign in with an enrolled account and a valid credential before it can be launched on a managed workstation.
The compiler's hosted build service must require every developer to present a valid account credential before it accepts a source file for compilation.
The database server shall permit a connection only after the requesting user has been identified by a registered account and a matching credential.
The sales forecasting system shall reject any analyst login secret whose entropy is lower than 64 bits at the time it is set.
The simulation software must accept a new operator credential only when its estimated strength is at least 64 bits of entropy.
The smart-card electronic purse shall accept a cardholder's PIN or passphrase for card activation only when it provides at least 64 bits of strength.

The hospital patient-record system shall allow a nurse's account to hold an authenticated session on only one workstation at a time and shall reject a second concurrent sign-in with the same credentials.
The data warehousing system must limit each analyst identity to a single authenticated session at any moment, refusing a further login from another client while one is active.

The smart-card electronic purse shall attach a cryptographic checksum to the stored balance and shall reject any balance value whose checksum does not match, so that corruption or tampering is detected.
The screen capture tool must compute a digest of every saved recording and compare it on opening, flagging the file as altered whenever the digests differ.
The data warehousing system shall validate the consistency of each loaded record against its source checksum and shall discard any record that has been modified or damaged in transit.
The database server shall run an anti-malware scanner that inspects uploaded files and backup imports and quarantines any file detected as malicious.
The simulation software must scan every third-party model plug-in for malicious code before loading it and must refuse to load any plug-in flagged as infected.
The sales forecasting system shall continuously monitor its host for malware and intrusion signatures and shall isolate the affected component when a threat is detected.
The sales forecasting system shall permit only analysts holding the forecast-editor role to create or change forecast scenarios.
The online booking system shall allow only staff with reservation-management privileges to create, modify or cancel bookings on behalf of customers.
The database server shall grant write and delete permissions on production tables solely to accounts that have been explicitly assigned a data-modification privilege.
The web browser shall prevent web pages from reading or altering the files that store saved credentials and browsing profiles, exposing them only through its controlled interfaces.
The electronic purse shall keep the stored balance unreadable and unalterable by external devices except through its defined load and debit commands.
The data warehousing system must reject a reversal of a loaded record unless it originates from the same source feed as the original load and carries identical row counts and totals.
The online booking system must accept a refund for a reservation only when it is issued from the same terminal that took the original payment and equals the amount originally charged.

The payroll and human resources management system shall attach a keyed message authentication code, derived from a key held only by the communicating servers, to each salary file exchanged between them so that any modification is detected.
The smart-home IoT controller must verify a keyed authentication tag on every command received from a paired hub and discard any command whose tag does not match.
The simulation software shall compute a keyed checksum over the number of runs and the aggregate result values in each exported result set, so that later tampering with those figures is detectable.
The smart-home IoT controller must append a keyed authentication code covering the event count and cumulative energy reading to each telemetry bundle it uploads.

The data warehousing system shall flag any loaded dataset whose recomputed integrity code differs from the code supplied by the source, and shall start a correction procedure to restore the affected records.
The web browser shall refuse to run a downloaded extension whose signature fails verification and shall offer the user a way to restore the previously installed version.
The online booking system shall compute a fresh integrity code over the running total of reservations and revenue each time a booking is confirmed, and shall store that code with the batch record.

The air traffic control software must sign each clearance message it issues and recompute the checksum of the clearance sequence log whenever an entry is appended, so that altered entries can be detected.

The electronic purse shall, upon reversing its latest debit, restore the prior balance and regenerate the authentication code that covers the cumulative debit total, before releasing the record for collection.

The database server shall recompute the checksum covering the row count and sum of an aggregated ledger whenever a transaction is rolled back, and shall retain the rolled-back entry unchanged until archival.
The electronic purse must accept a top-up instruction only if it carries a valid authentication code computed with the key negotiated for the current session.
The database server shall execute a replication instruction from a peer node only if the accompanying message authentication code verifies against the per-connection session key.
The air traffic control software shall let a supervisor suspend a compromised workstation session remotely, and shall refuse every command from a suspended session.
The web browser shall block all further requests from an extension that the vendor has revoked as malicious, including after a restart.
The online banking application must allow the bank to freeze a customer profile showing signs of takeover and must deny every operation attempted on a frozen profile.
The smart-home IoT controller shall generate and store its encryption keys exclusively inside a tamper-resistant hardware module, so that key material is never readable outside it.
The hospital patient-record system must keep the keys that encrypt patient files in a certified hardware vault that never exports them in plaintext.
The screen capture tool shall hold the keys used to encrypt saved recordings in the operating system's hardware-backed key store, preventing other applications from reading them.

The hospital patient-record system shall abort any prescription order, and report it as failed, when a mismatch is detected in the patient identifier, drug code or dosage fields as compared with their protected checksum.
The electronic purse must decline a payment and leave the balance untouched when the verification code over the transaction number, currency and value indicates the data were modified in transit.
The online booking system must cancel a pending reservation and notify the user of the failure when the signed booking reference, date or price is found to have been manipulated.
The hospital patient-record system shall use a distinct encryption key for each participating clinic so that one clinic's key can never decrypt another clinic's patient records.
The simulation software must keep the cryptographic keys of each tenant organisation in isolated key stores so that no tenant can read the model data of another tenant.
The database server shall assign each hosted customer its own encryption key hierarchy so that data encrypted for one customer remains unreadable to every other customer.
The compiler shall expose its plugin interface in a way that prevents third-party plugins from disabling or tampering with the compiler's code-signing and sandbox checks.
The payroll and human resources management system must offer its extension API so that no extension can switch off, alter or evade the system's intrusion-detection and request-throttling controls.
The simulation software shall ensure that user-supplied scripts running inside it cannot deactivate or modify the software's attack-detection and lockdown mechanisms.
The online booking system shall erase the memory buffers holding a customer's payment details before releasing them so that no later session can read residual values.
The online banking application must overwrite any memory region that held account balances or transaction data before that region is allocated to another process.
The smart-home IoT controller shall clear memory that held camera streams or door-lock credentials before it is handed to any other task, preventing disclosure of leftover content.
The compiler shall deliver each intermediate representation passed between its compilation stages to the next stage without any modification.
The simulation software must verify that every message exchanged between its distributed simulation nodes arrives at the receiving node with its content unchanged.
The compiler shall present an interface to build plugins that makes it impossible for a plugin to bypass, switch off or corrupt the compiler's integrity-verification and hardening features.
The online banking application must provide third-party integrations with an interface through which they cannot evade, disable or tamper with its fraud-detection and brute-force protection controls.

The payroll and human resources management system shall give integrated modules an access layer that prevents them from circumventing or deactivating its malicious-activity detection and blocking functions.
The smart-home IoT controller shall apply a change to its automation rules or firmware only when the change has been approved by the registered household owner.
The online banking application must permit modification of a customer's payee list only after the account holder has explicitly approved the modification.
The data warehousing system shall encrypt the datasets of each loaded data source while they are being ingested and, where configured, while they are queried afterwards.
The simulation software must encrypt scenario configuration files during their provisioning to a simulation node and may continue encrypting them during later runs.
The compiler shall encrypt proprietary source modules while they are being imported into a build workspace so that unauthorised parties cannot read them.
The hospital patient-record system shall return to each client module only the patient fields that the module's function needs and shall withhold all other fields.
The screen capture tool must grant integrated applications access only to the windows and screen regions they are actively authorised to record, and hide the remaining screen content.
The smart-home IoT controller shall let each connected app read only the device states needed for that app's purpose and conceal every other household sensor reading.
The database server shall encrypt all client connections using a negotiated channel protocol so that query traffic cannot be read in transit.
The web browser must transmit page requests and responses over an encrypted transport protocol so that eavesdroppers on the network cannot read their content.
The hospital patient-record system shall exchange patient data with external clinics only through an encrypted communication channel.
The database server shall support at least one encrypted replication protocol for traffic between primary and replica nodes so that replicated rows cannot be read in transit.
The payroll and human resources management system must send salary files to external banking partners only over an encrypted transfer protocol.
The air traffic control software shall exchange flight-plan data between control centres using at least one encrypted link protocol that prevents interception of the content.
The simulation software should support symmetric-key encryption of saved simulation results so that stored results can be read only by holders of the key.
The online banking application shall encrypt stored customer statements with a symmetric block cipher so that anyone obtaining the storage media cannot read them.
The air traffic control software should be able to encrypt radar track records with a symmetric cipher so that unauthorised readers cannot interpret them.
The smart-home IoT controller may use public-key encryption to protect the pairing secrets exchanged with new devices from disclosure to nearby eavesdroppers.
The air traffic control software may use public-key encryption to conceal session keys when they are distributed to remote control towers.
The online booking system may employ public-key cryptography to encrypt customers' travel documents so that only the booking operator's private key can decrypt them.

The smart-home controller shall offer installed device integrations a service that converts arbitrary sensor and camera payloads into ciphertext before they leave the hub, so that only the paired mobile app can read them.
The database server must provide column-level cryptographic transformation of stored values so that a person with raw access to the data files cannot read the contents of designated fields.
The compiler shall let build scripts obfuscate embedded string literals and licence keys within the output binary so that they cannot be read by inspecting the executable.
The web browser shall compare a cryptographic digest of every downloaded extension package against the digest published by its store and shall refuse to install the package when the two differ.
The screen capture tool must attach a keyed hash to each saved recording and shall verify that hash on playback so that any edit made to the file after capture is detected.
The air traffic control software shall encrypt flight-plan updates exchanged between control centres so that an eavesdropper on the network link cannot interpret their contents.
The web browser must transmit form submissions only over encrypted connections so that intermediaries on the network path are unable to read the submitted values.
The electronic purse shall encrypt balance and transaction data exchanged with a merchant terminal so that a device that has not proven its identity cannot read that data.
The data warehousing system shall encrypt customer records moving from the extraction service to the load service so that no unauthorised party can read them while in transit.
The hospital patient-record system must keep diagnosis details hidden from unauthorised staff and external systems whenever it sends them to the pharmacy module.
The sales forecasting system shall prevent unauthorised readers from viewing confidential revenue figures that it passes from the data collector to the model engine.
The simulation software shall check, upon receiving proprietary model parameters from a remote solver node, that the parameters arrived under encryption and shall reject them if they did not.
The online banking application must confirm that account statements received from the core ledger service were delivered through an encrypted channel before it displays them to the customer.
The online booking system shall validate that guest passport and payment details received from a partner agency were shielded against disclosure in transit, and shall discard any that were not.
The hospital patient-record system shall block further sign-in attempts from an account for a defined period after a configured number of consecutive failed attempts.
The online booking system must slow down and eventually refuse repeated failed login requests originating from the same network address in order to hinder automated guessing.
The screen capture tool shall suspend unlocking of its protected recording library after several unsuccessful unlock attempts and shall require a waiting period before accepting another try.

When a clinician's credential check fails, the hospital patient-record system shall deny access, apply the configured response such as a temporary lockout, and notify the genuine account holder if the credentials were presented again after having been captured.

The simulation software must reject a compute node whose certificate fails verification and shall react according to the configured policy, including isolating that node from the cluster when repeated forged identities are detected.

If a controller's identity check or privilege check fails, the air traffic control software shall refuse the session and shall execute the response defined by the operating authority, which may include alerting the legitimate controller about reused login tokens.
The smart-home controller shall recognise when a previously captured pairing message from a door lock or sensor is sent again and shall flag it as an attack.
The online booking system must detect when a session token that was already used and retired is presented again by a client.
The online banking application shall identify one-time authorisation codes that have been submitted more than once and shall treat the repeat as a replay attempt.
When the web browser finds that an authentication assertion from a site has been resubmitted by an attacker, it shall terminate the affected browsing session and clear its authenticated state.
Upon identifying a replayed transfer authorisation, the online banking application must halt the pending payment and end the customer session involved.
If the compiler's licence server connection receives a re-sent licence grant that it has already honoured, the compiler shall abort the running build job and release its licence checkout.

The database server shall enforce a documented data-protection rule that lists which tables and fields hold personal or business-critical content and limits their viewing to explicitly permitted roles.
The electronic purse must apply a written rule that identifies cardholder identity data and spending history as information to be kept from any reader other than the authorised issuer.

The smart-home controller shall follow a configurable policy naming occupancy patterns and camera footage as sensitive data that cannot be exposed to third-party services without the owner's permission.
When the compiler detects that its telemetry feature is about to send source code fragments contrary to the configured disclosure rules, it shall drop all outbound telemetry messages.
If the web browser determines that a page script attempts to read data in breach of the configured privacy rules, the browser must block every pending network request from that page.

Should the online banking application detect that an outgoing message would expose account holder details contrary to its privacy rules, it shall suppress all messages in that exchange, including those to partner institutions.
The online banking application shall add a unique incrementing counter to each administrative command sent to the payment gateway so that a re-sent command can be told apart from a new one.
The electronic purse must include a time value or running sequence number in every top-up request it issues to the loading terminal so that stale copies of earlier requests are rejected.

The hospital patient-record system shall stamp every configuration update sent to a connected bedside device with the current time or a message counter, enabling the receiver to discard repeated updates.
The hospital patient-record system shall reject any clinical data exchange message whose nonce or sequence counter duplicates one already accepted from the same sending device.
The smart-home IoT controller shall discard any actuator command that carries a timestamp outside the permitted freshness window, so that recorded commands cannot be resent to operate a door lock.
The payroll and human resources management system must detect and refuse a resubmitted salary-change transaction that repeats the unique identifier of an earlier processed transaction.
When a customer's booking session times out, the online booking system shall erase the personal details and payment data entered during that session from all temporary storage.

Once an analyst's forecasting job ends, the sales forecasting system must purge the intermediate customer-level datasets and cached results generated for that job so that later users cannot read them.
After a guest's temporary access grant lapses, the smart-home IoT controller shall wipe the occupancy and routine data it collected about that guest during the grant.
The database server shall return query results only for the tables and rows that the requesting account has been granted permission to read.
The hospital patient-record system must release a patient's medical history only to clinicians who are assigned to that patient's care.
If the simulation software detects tampering with its model files or an unexpected halt caused by hostile input, it shall stop the run and return to a predefined clean configuration.
When the data warehousing system detects that a load job has been disrupted by an intrusion or malicious input, it must abort the job and place the affected tables into a read-only state.
When the smart-home IoT controller detects that its firmware has been interfered with, it shall switch all connected locks and heating devices to preconfigured fallback settings.
The compiler shall refuse remote connections to its build-cache service from any client that is not on the list of approved build agents.
The smart-card electronic purse must prevent card readers that are not approved by the issuer from reading the stored balance and transaction data.
The smart-home IoT controller shall deny wireless network joining to every device that the homeowner has not explicitly approved.
The simulation software shall expose the addresses and capacity of its remote compute nodes only to users holding a simulation-administrator role.
The web browser must prevent web pages from enumerating the hosts and services present on the user's internal network.
The air traffic control software shall show the topology of external radar-feed links solely to authorised controllers and supervisors.
When a technician runs remote diagnostics on the smart-home IoT controller, the controller shall hide residents' presence history and voice recordings from the diagnostic output.
The compiler must remove user names, file paths and source snippets from crash reports before they are made available to support staff.
During maintenance diagnostics, the air traffic control software shall mask the personal identities of crew and passengers in any data shown to the maintenance engineer.
The payroll and human resources management system shall block inbound traffic from the internet that is not a reply to a connection started from inside the internal network.
The online booking system must drop unsolicited incoming packets that do not belong to an established session, so that port scans and flooding attempts do not reach its application servers.
The online banking application shall track the state of every network connection to its back-end and discard packets that do not match a legitimate ongoing exchange.
The database server shall let an administrator run a check that detects whether any stored record has been altered since it was last written by an authorised process.
The compiler must verify, before linking, that each cached object file matches the checksum recorded when it was produced and reject any file that differs.
The hospital patient-record system shall allow auditors to confirm that archived medical records are identical to the versions originally saved.

The online booking system shall allow a travel agency employee to sign a group reservation on behalf of the agency using a private signing key that is kept hidden from all other users, so that any later change to the reservation is detectable.

The compiler must sign each release build on behalf of the development team with a private key that is never disclosed to individual developers, so that any modification of the binary invalidates the signature.

The hospital patient-record system shall let a physician sign a discharge summary for the care team with a private key accessible only to that physician, so that alteration of the summary is detectable.
The web browser shall check embedded ownership marks in downloaded images and flag any image whose mark has been removed or changed.
The compiler must detect when the same embedded provenance mark appears in sources submitted by different contributors and report the conflicting submissions.
The smart-home IoT controller shall verify the embedded ownership mark of each firmware image offered by different vendors and reject any image whose mark has been modified.
The compiler shall check each imported library for an embedded origin mark and report to the developer whether the mark proves the declared publisher.
The sales forecasting system must inform the analyst, for each imported dataset, whether it carries a verifiable source stamp that confirms the identity of the data provider.
The payroll system shall verify the personal identification number entered by an employee against the stored reference value before granting access to that employee's pay slips.
The web browser must verify the PIN typed by the user against the stored value before it unlocks the saved credential vault.

The simulation software shall let a reviewing institution check the digital signature on a submitted scenario file with the group public key, confirming that the file originated from a member of the authorised research consortium without revealing which member signed it.

The air traffic control software must validate the group signature attached to each flight plan message using the group public key, so that the controller can confirm the message came from a registered airline without learning which dispatcher signed it.
The booking system shall let a customer define a dedicated passphrase that must be correctly supplied before the contact email address on the customer's profile can be modified.
The banking application must prompt the account holder for a separately configured secret credential and verify it before accepting any change to the registered email address.

The smart-home controller shall confirm the identity of a person using its configuration console by comparing typing rhythm together with pointer movement patterns against the enrolled profile of that person.

The compiler service must establish the identity of a developer submitting a build job by matching keystroke timing and cursor motion characteristics to the biometric profile registered for that developer.
The database server shall identify each client connection by validating a submitted account name and its matching secret before any query is executed.
The sales forecasting system must verify the login name and secret phrase supplied by an analyst against the registered account before the analyst can open any forecast.
The simulation software shall permit changes to stored simulation parameters only by the user who entered them and only after that user's identity has been verified.
The compiler shall reject any edit to a saved build configuration unless the edit is made by the configuration's owner following successful identity verification.
The web browser must allow bookmarks and saved form entries to be modified solely by the profile owner who has been verified in the current session.
The data warehousing system must restrict changes to the access rights on warehouse tables to the warehouse's designated data administrator.
The sales forecasting system shall allow only the data administrator role to alter which users are entitled to edit forecast datasets.
The screen capture tool shall prevent anyone other than the designated administrator from changing the rights that govern who may edit or delete stored recordings.

The booking system shall allow only the data administrator to change the rights governing modification of reservation records, and shall store a hash of each reservation record so that any alteration can be detected.
The patient-record system must restrict modification of record-editing privileges to the data administrator and must keep a hash value for every stored clinical entry to reveal unauthorised changes.
The data warehousing system shall limit updates of table-level write privileges to the data administrator and shall compute and retain a digest of each loaded dataset so tampering can be identified.
The sales forecasting system must grant a session only when the submitted credentials match a registered account and must otherwise return the user to the sign-in screen to retry.
The online banking application shall admit a customer only if the entered customer identifier and credential are confirmed as valid, and shall redisplay the sign-in form when they are not.
The screen capture tool shall let a new user register an account and shall authenticate that user on later launches by matching a scanned fingerprint to the enrolled template.
The simulation software must support enrolment of a researcher's fingerprint when an account is created and must require a matching fingerprint scan to start each session.
The electronic purse shall attach a keyed message authentication code to every transaction log entry stored on the card so that any modification of an entry can be detected when the log is read.
The booking system must compute a keyed hash-based message authentication code over each audit file and must flag a file whose code no longer matches its content.

The compiler's remote build service must authenticate each client with a valid certificate before accepting any compilation job.

The simulation software shall let a researcher validate that saved model parameters and result files have not been modified since they were written.
The online banking application shall provide an auditor with a function to confirm that stored transaction records match their original recorded checksums.
The screen capture tool shall prevent any process other than the authorised capture session from modifying or deleting recordings that have already been saved.
The sales forecasting system must restrict write access to historical sales figures to authorised analysts so that unauthorised users cannot change the figures used in forecasts.
The database server shall reject any attempt by an unprivileged account to insert, update or delete records in protected tables.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to prove their identity with valid credentials before a recording session can be started.
The compiler shall require a developer to present valid credentials before it accepts a build request on the shared build service.

The data warehousing system must enable a data steward to run a check that proves archived fact tables are identical to the versions originally loaded.
The database server shall offer an administrator a command that validates stored data pages against recorded checksums and reports every mismatch.

The screen capture tool shall verify the validity and trust chain of the upload server's certificate before transmitting any recording.

The hospital patient-record system shall reject any update that would leave a patient's medication, allergy and diagnosis entries mutually inconsistent.
The smart-card electronic purse must detect and refuse any attempt to alter the stored balance outside a completed and validated load or debit operation.

The smart-card electronic purse must calculate a hash over every transaction record it stores, enabling the terminal to detect tampering with that record.

The online booking system must ensure that the reservation details displayed to a customer at confirmation are identical to those stored when the booking was created.
